	<ResortReportHeadline>A Sunny Stunner!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks as though we're in for a ripper Friday in the mountains. The sky is filled with stars, there's an alpenglow out to the east and it won't be long before the sun makes an appearance.</p><p>The current temp is +0.1, headed for a very pleasant top of 5 degrees and right now there's a moderate wind from the SW. Even though it's not super cold, the snow has had a freeze and will start out firm before softening later on.</p><p>It sure was great to get the Drift up and running yesterday and there'll be more fun turns to be had out there today. Start off on the groomers before moving around to your preferred off piste options as the day warms.</p><p>Road Runner will be spinning from 7:30am for WRX First Tracks which is also where the ANC Series is taking place. Stop by the track and check out all the action where some of the world's best Snowboard Cross and Ski Cross athletes will be racing, including our very own Olympic gold medallist Josie Baff. Best of luck to all the competitors.</p><p>Slap on the sunscreen and have a ripper day. Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
